interpretation.supported: The exact consumed source bytes and all 11 contact shapeIDs are reproducible. Its published metadata reports 2010 representation and 326 units; the source metadata credits geoBoundaries/Wikimedia and does not give a traceable official Greek geometry lineage for each boundary. A Greek government catalogue identifies a much better purpose/vintage match (Kallikratis) but the source bytes were unavailable for inspection. The consumed simplified source is therefore useful for historical source-relative context and identity joins, but cannot be treated as sufficient authority to close boundary/source questions or certify present land/water status.
interpretation.unresolved: No official source geometry was obtained for direct comparison; source-license applicability, per-feature lineage/accuracy, exact 2010 administrative fit, and the seven numeric construction contradictions remain unresolved. All 18 numeric unknowns and all physical query prerequisites remain open.
interpretation.inference: The “source-relative only” fitness conclusion follows from the mismatch between source metadata provenance and the absence of directly inspected official local geometry; it is a suitability limit, not a finding that any particular feature is wrong or missing.
